thread:
Ava Chen: Quick thread to lock down customer comms and post-postmortem actions after the latency spike in eu-west-1. Need: one-line status update, 3-paragraph customer summary timeline, explicit RCA redaction rules, and owners + deadlines for remediation.

Jon Rivera: I'm on short notice for the statuspage post. Can someone paste 1-2 sentence copy I can publish?

Marta Reyes: Draft statuspage: "We experienced a partial service degradation impacting inference latency in eu-west-1 for ~35 minutes. We reverted a scaling change and applied a temporary cache TTL increase; full RCA and remediation plan to follow." Thoughts?

Priya Patel: Good. Avoid naming internal components; prefer generic terms ("scaling change" vs autoscaler internals). Legal asked we always offer a path to request more detail via support rather than linking raw logs.

Miguel Torres: Noted. For the customer summary, I'll draft a 3-paragraph that covers: timeline, customer impact, and next steps. I'll include an FAQ entry on "Can I get more data?" that points to support@redwood.ai.

Samir Gupta: I'll own the cache TTL permanent change and the test-run in staging. Action id: cache-perm-2026. ETA: 48 hours for rollout + 24h validation. I'll post PR link here when ready.

Ava Chen: Samir -> cache-perm-2026 (48h + 24h validation). Miguel -> customer-summary draft (EOD today). Jon -> statuspage publish (1h). Priya -> compliance review of draft (within 24h).

Priya Patel: On RCA redaction: policy reminder ":" Publish technical RCA but remove PII, redact raw vendor timestamps and IP addresses, and replace with aggregated timelines. Attach anonymized traces only. I'll run a compliance pass and mark items to redact.

LegalBot: Compliance check flagged: remove vendor internal IDs and any debug tokens. Approve publication after redaction.

Marta Reyes: For the customer doc I'll add a short "what we're changing long-term" section: autoscaler cooldown tuning, combined autoscaler+cache integration tests in staging, and improved observability alerts for burst patterns.

Ava Chen: Important: ops note — this is the fourth autoscaler/cache correlated incident in the past 7 months. Add a recurring-pattern action to the postmortem: "incident-patterns-autoscaler-cache" -> owners: Miguel + Samir. Propose a 60-min follow-up workshop next week to finalize durable mitigations.

Miguel Torres: I can facilitate the workshop. Proposed attendees: infra, runtime, QA, product. Available Tues or Wed next week.

Jon Rivera: I'll lock in Tue 2pm if that works for infra.

Samir Gupta: That works. Also creating a short test matrix for autoscaler+cache scenarios this week. Will link test PR.

OpsBot: Checklist created: [x] draft statuspage text, [ ] statuspage published, [ ] customer summary draft, [ ] compliance review, [ ] remediation PRs linked, [ ] workshop scheduled. Reminders set for 1h, 24h, 48h.

Priya Patel: One more: we should standardize RCA attachments policy in the postmortem so future RCAs have a "redaction checklist" template. I'll draft a template and add it to the incident doc.

Ava Chen: Great. Recap of owners/timers: Jon -> publish statuspage (1h), Miguel -> customer summary (EOD), Priya -> redaction template + compliance pass (24h), Samir -> cache perm + tests (48-72h), Miguel+Samir -> pattern workshop (next Tue 14:00). We'll close loop after workshop and update customers if any timeline changes. Ping this thread with PR links and draft URLs.

Jon Rivera: Posting statuspage now. Will paste link here once live.

OpsBot: Statuspage entry posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/eu-west-1-2026-03- Thereply-to-customer-summary-thread scheduled.

Ava Chen: Thanks everyone. Good job moving fast on owners.
